subject: Pystan compile error:   pystan/_chains.pyx:198:32: Cannot assign type 'double' to 'long'

messages.author: 7b2fb40653accdcf
messages.subject: Pystan compile error:   pystan/_chains.pyx:198:32: Cannot assign type 'double' to 'long'
parts:
Hello,

After installing numpy and cython then downloading and expanding pystan-2.7.0.0.tar.gz I get the following compile error:

pystan/_chains.pyx:198:32: Cannot assign type 'double' to 'long'

This is on a linux (Fedora 22) using python 2.7

Here is the output from the terminal window:

[root@localhost pystan-2.7.0.0]# python setup.py install
Compiling pystan/_api.pyx because it depends on /usr/lib64/python2.7/site-packages/Cython/Includes/libcpp/string.pxd.
Compiling pystan/_chains.pyx because it changed.
[1/2] Cythonizing pystan/_chains.pyx

Error compiling Cython file:
------------------------------------------------------------
...
    cdef vector[double] samples, split_chain
    for chain in range(n_chains):
        samples.clear()
        get_kept_samples(sim, chain, n, samples)
        split_chain.clear()
        for i in range(n_samples/2):
                               ^
------------------------------------------------------------

pystan/_chains.pyx:198:32: Cannot assign type 'double' to 'long'

Error compiling Cython file:
------------------------------------------------------------
...
            split_chain.push_back(samples[i])
        split_chain_mean.push_back(stan_mean(split_chain))
        split_chain_var.push_back(stan_variance(split_chain))

        split_chain.clear()
        for i in range(n_samples/2, n_samples):
                               ^
------------------------------------------------------------

pystan/_chains.pyx:204:32: Cannot assign type 'double' to 'long'
Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "setup.py", line 228, in <module>
    setup_package()
  File "setup.py", line 212, in setup_package
    metadata['ext_modules'] = cythonize(extensions)
  File "/usr/lib64/python2.7/site-packages/Cython/Build/Dependencies.py", line 877, in cythonize
    cythonize_one(*args)
  File "/usr/lib64/python2.7/site-packages/Cython/Build/Dependencies.py", line 997, in cythonize_one
    raise CompileError(None, pyx_file)
Cython.Compiler.Errors.CompileError: pystan/_chains.pyx
[root@localhost pystan-2.7.0.0]#

messages.author: f4c2e63aec3c6db2
messages.subject: Re: [stan-users] Pystan compile error:   pystan/_chains.pyx:198:32: Cannot assign type 'double' to 'long'
parts:
Hi Eugene,

Thanks for the bug report. There's a new release of Cython that's
creating this bug. PyStan should have a point release out today.

Best,

Allen
